hints.title: THE DARK
hints.text: The deepest mines are dark: you see about five tiles. A lamp (key 2) doubles that for 12 seconds. And down here nothing saves your place but a refuge chamber: step inside one, and if the mine claims you later, you return to it for 100 points instead of starting again.
hints.task: Take the lamp beside you and light it. Find the refuge chamber under this tunnel and step inside it before you go on.

hints.title: GAS
hints.text: Ahead, a shaft climbs into galleries full of gas. Gas rises and spreads sideways, never sinks, and in it you suffocate in about three seconds. The way on runs through more than forty tiles of it. A mask (key 4) gives 20 seconds of clean air.
hints.task: Take the mask. Put it on at the foot of the shaft, climb in and follow the galleries to their end without stopping.

hints.title: A NEW REFUGE
hints.text: You are through. Each refuge you enter replaces the last one as the place you return to. If you are ever stuck with no way on, pause (P) and go back to it from there.
hints.task: Step into the refuge chamber two tiles further down, on the west side of this shaft, before you go on.

hints.title: FIREDAMP
hints.text: In the hall ahead, gas hangs under the roof, fed by a vent that also blocks the way on. Because gas never sinks, you can walk beneath it. A blast within two tiles of gas sets the whole cloud alight at once, burns the vent away, and kills anyone standing next to any part of the cloud.
hints.task: Fetch the stick from the far end of the hall. Come back to the low tunnel at the hall's mouth, lay the stick there (key 1) and step back two tiles.

hints.title: TUNNEL BORER
hints.text: Below you a tunnel borer drives to and fro. It fills its tunnel from floor to roof: you cannot pass it, and its touch is fatal. It leaves elements lying. The titanium is at the west end, the way out is a hole in the floor at the east end, and the only place to hide is this shaft.
hints.task: From here you see only the middle of its tunnel: light the lamp to see all of it. Let the borer pass beneath you, go the other way, and be back in this shaft before it returns. Then let it pass again and go to the other end.

hints.title: READY FOR THE DEEP
hints.text: Darkness, refuges, gas, firedamp and the borer: you have dealt with every one of them. That was the last lesson. Take the iron and the exit: the missions are waiting!
